facts.fact: The EACO report lists Burundi among its seven member states, with Burundi's regulator ARCT submitting data; the report gives no date for membership, so its publication date is used.

EACO reports Burundi's inbound One Network Area voice traffic rose 126% in 2025, from 89.6 million to 202.9 million minutes, and outbound rose 82.4% from 12.1 million to 22.1 million, attributing the rise to Burundi's accession to the ONA roaming framework and reduced roaming tariffs.
